scientific_question: In the annular-combustor flow field, identify one scientifically relevant coherent constant-density structure. Choose and state a rule for setting the Density isovalue from the finite stored Density values. At that level, treat each connected isosurface component as a candidate, select the component with the largest surface area, and represent it by its area-weighted centroid and surface area. Report the selected structure’s centroid, Density isovalue, and surface area.
